Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
As you do not enter combat as a blocking minion until you have
successfully blocked and tapped, can Obedience therefore be played by
a tapped minion that is not blocking but nevertheless is about to
enter combat with a minion?

T

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Talonz51" <Talo...@hotmail.com> wrote in message
news:3bedff20.525647979@news...



No.
You must be untapped to play any reaction card.
(or have the ability to play cards as though untapped, ie Wake)

See the definition of reaction cards in section 1.6.3.5 in the
Final Nights or online rulebook.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec1_6_3

"A ready untapped minion can play a reaction card in response to
an action taken by another Methuselah's minion (an action taken
by one of a Methuselah's minions cannot be reacted to by any of
her own minions). "

Carpe noctem.

?
Not sure what you mean by "with which", but, to be clear, If you are
"about to enter combat" because of an acting minion's Bum's Rush
against you that has just moved to the resolution step (enter combat)
after having not been blocked, you are free to play Obedience (without
blocking) if you are untapped (or woken), by card text.
